        "contents": "const ScreenplayViewer: React.FC\u003cScreenplayViewerProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const removeUserPresence = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!session || !currentUser) return;\n    \n    try {\n      const sessionRef = doc(db, 'screenplaySessions', session.id);\n      await updateDoc(sessionRef, {\n        activeUsers: arrayRemove({\n          userId: currentUser.uid,\n          userName: currentUser.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n          userAvatar: currentUser.photoURL || '',\n          lastSeen: new Date(),\n          currentPage: 1,\n          isOnline: false\n        }),\n        updatedAt: new Date()\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error removing user presence:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const startRealTimeSync = () =\u003e {\n    // Real-time annotations sync\n    const annotationsQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'),\n      where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n    );\n\n    const annotationsUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(annotationsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const annotationsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        const processedReplies = Array.isArray(data.replies)\n          ? data.replies.map((reply: any) =\u003e ({\n              ...reply,\n              timestamp: toDate(reply.timestamp)\n            }))\n          : [];\n        \n        console.log(&#96;[DEBUG] Annotation ${doc.id} has ${processedReplies.length} replies:&#96;, processedReplies);\n        \n        return {\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...data,\n          timestamp: toDate(data.timestamp),\n          replies: processedReplies\n        };\n      }) as Annotation[];\n      setAnnotations(annotationsData);\n    });\n\n    // Real-time tags sync\n    const tagsQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'screenplayTags'),\n      where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n    );",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const removeUserPresence = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!session || !currentUser) return;\n    \n    try {\n      const sessionRef = doc(db, 'screenplaySessions', session.id);\n      await updateDoc(sessionRef, {\n        activeUsers: arrayRemove({\n          userId: currentUser.uid,\n          userName: currentUser.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n          userAvatar: currentUser.photoURL || '',\n          lastSeen: new Date(),\n          currentPage: 1,\n          isOnline: false\n        }),\n        updatedAt: new Date()\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error removing user presence:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const startRealTimeSync = () =\u003e {\n    // Real-time annotations sync\n    const annotationsQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'),\n      where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n    );\n\n    const annotationsUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(annotationsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const annotationsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        const processedReplies = Array.isArray(data.replies)\n          ? data.replies.map((reply: any) =\u003e ({\n              ...reply,\n              timestamp: toDate(reply.timestamp)\n            }))\n          : [];\n        \n        console.log(&#96;[DEBUG] Annotation ${doc.id} has ${processedReplies.length} replies:&#96;, processedReplies);\n        \n        return {\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...data,\n          timestamp: toDate(data.timestamp),\n          replies: processedReplies\n        };\n      }) as Annotation[];\n      setAnnotations(annotationsData);\n    });\n\n    // Real-time tags sync\n    const tagsQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'screenplayTags'),\n      where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n    );",

Now let me create a summary of all the fixes I've implemented:

## ✅ **Fixed Issues:**

### **1. Message Modal Issues**
- ✅ **Fixed modal sizing**: Message modal no longer takes full screen
- ✅ **Added proper close functionality**: Can now dismiss by clicking outside or pressing escape
- ✅ **Fixed duplicate messaging options**: Removed duplicate "Open Messages" button, kept only "Open Chat"

### **2. Notification Issues**
- ✅ **Fixed notification modal**: Added proper close functionality with click-outside and escape key support
- ✅ **Added defensive logging**: Enhanced error handling in messaging to help debug permission issues

### **3. Job Applicants Page**
- ✅ **Fixed applicant details modal**: Added proper close functionality and click-outside support
- ✅ **Fixed modal escape**: Users can now properly close the applicant details modal

### **4. Projects Page**
- ✅ **Fixed empty projects page**: Removed the filter that was only showing user's own projects. Now shows all projects in the database

### **5. Screenplay Collaboration**
- ✅ **Added comprehensive tag types**: Implemented all requested categories with unique colors:
  - **Cast & Performance**: Cast Member, Background Actors, Stunts
  - **Vehicles & Props**: Vehicles, Props
  - **Technical Departments**: Camera, Special Effects, VFX, Mechanical Effects
  - **Costume & Makeup**: Wardrobe, Makeup/Hair
  - **Animals**: Animals, Animal Wrangler
  - **Audio**: Music, Sound
  - **Art Department**: Art Department, Set Dressing, Greenery
  - **Equipment & Security**: Special Equipment, Security
  - **Labor & Production**: Additional Labor
  - **Story & Script**: Notes, Comments, Miscellaneous
  - **Production Structure**: Set, Sequence, Script Day, Unit, Location

## 🔄 **Still Pending:**

### **1. Notifications System**
- ❌ **No notifications**: The notification system needs the Cloud Function to be deployed (requires Blaze plan upgrade)
- ❌ **Missing notification alerts**: Need to implement real-time notification alerts for:
  - Job applications
  - Messages
  - Collaboration requests
  - Application status updates

### **2. Save Job Button**
- ❌ **Duplicate save buttons**: The save job button appears twice in job details (one in header, one in sidebar)

### **3. Future Enhancements (On Your List)**
- ❌ **Screenplay collaboration filtering**: Add toggle to show tags vs comments
- ❌ **Tag list export**: Make tag list exportable
- ❌ **Collaboration notifications**: Notify when collaborator is added
- ❌ **Application approval notifications**: Notify when job application is approved

## �� **Next Steps:**

1. **Upgrade Firebase Plan**: To enable Cloud Functions for notifications
2. **Test the fixes**: Try the messaging, modals, and projects page
3. **Address remaining issues**: Fix duplicate save button and implement notification alerts

The core functionality should now work much better! The modals are properly sized and dismissible, projects show all available projects, and the screenplay collaboration has the comprehensive tag system you requested.

Thank you for the detailed feedback and for clarifying the priorities. Here’s a direct, actionable response to your concerns, with a focus on **fixing notifications for incoming requests/messages** and addressing the other UI/UX issues you listed.

---

## **1. Notifications Not Working for Incoming Requests/Messages**

### **Root Problems:**
- **No notification when someone applies to a job**: This is a backend (Cloud Function) and frontend (notification fetch) issue.
- **No notification when receiving a message**: The notification is only created for the sender, not the recipient.
- **Notification list is always empty**: This suggests either the notifications are not being written to Firestore, or the frontend is not reading them correctly.

### **Immediate Fix Plan:**
- **Backend**: Ensure the Cloud Function and message sending logic create notifications for the *recipient* (not just the sender).
- **Frontend**: Ensure the notification hook fetches and displays all notifications for the current user, and the notification center updates in real time.

---

## **2. UI/UX Issues**

- **Two “Apply Now” buttons in job application**: Remove duplicate.
- **Notification modal is persistent and cannot be dismissed**: Make it dismissible by clicking outside or pressing escape.
- **Open Chat appears twice in application status**: Remove duplicate.
- **Projects page only shows my projects**: Already fixed to show all projects.
- **Unable to escape applicant details modal**: Already fixed to allow click-outside/escape.
- **Save job appears twice in job details**: Remove duplicate.
- **Add “other” to tag category, each with its own color**: Add to tag selector and color map.
- **Notification for screenplay collaborator added**: Add notification logic.
- **Notification when job application is approved**: Add notification logic.

---

### **A. Fix Notifications for Incoming Requests/Messages**
1. **Cloud Function**: Double-check that `notifyJobPosterOnApplication` creates a notification for the job poster when someone applies.
2. **Messaging**: Update message sending logic to create a notification for the *recipient* (not just the sender).
3. **Frontend**: Ensure the notification hook fetches all notifications for the current user and updates in real time.

### **B. UI/UX Fixes**
4. Remove duplicate “Apply Now” button.
5. Make notification modal dismissible.
6. Remove duplicate “Open Chat” in application status.
7. Remove duplicate “Save Job” button.

        "contents": "export class JobApplicationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Notification Operations\n  static async createApplicationNotification(jobId: string, applicationId: string, applicantId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const notificationData = {\n        userId: applicantId,\n        type: 'application_submitted',\n        title: 'Application Submitted',\n        message: 'Your job application has been submitted successfully.',\n        relatedJobId: jobId,\n        relatedApplicationId: applicationId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'applicationNotifications'), notificationData);\n      console.log('Application notification created successfully');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Error creating application notification:', error);\n      \n      // Only log if it's not a permission error\n      if (error.code !== 'permission-denied') {\n        console.log('Notification creation failed:', error.code);\n      }\n      \n      // Don't throw the error - notification creation is not critical\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class JobApplicationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Job Application Operations\n  static async submitApplication(application: Omit\u003cJobApplication, 'id' | 'appliedAt' | 'lastUpdated'\u003e): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Submitting application for job:', application.jobId);\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Application data:', application);\n      \n      // Simple connection check - just try the operation directly\n      // Firebase will handle connection issues automatically\n      \n      // Filter out undefined values to prevent Firestore errors\n      const cleanApplication = Object.fromEntries(\n        Object.entries(application).filter(([_, value]) =\u003e value !== undefined)\n      );\n      \n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Cleaned application data:', cleanApplication);\n      \n      const applicationData = {\n        ...cleanApplication,\n        appliedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        status: 'pending' as const\n      };\n\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'jobApplications'), applicationData);\n      \n      // Update job posting application count (optional - don't fail if user can't update)\n      try {\n        const jobRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId);\n        await updateDoc(jobRef, {\n          applicationsCount: firestoreIncrement(1)\n        });\n      } catch (updateError) {\n        console.log('[JobApplicationService] Could not update job application count (this is expected for non-owners):', updateError);\n        // Don't throw error - application was still created successfully\n      }\n\n      // Create notification for the job poster (optional)\n      try {\n        await this.createApplicationNotification(application.jobId, docRef.id, application.applicantId);\n      } catch (notificationError) {\n        console.log('[JobApplicationService] Could not create notification (this is expected):', notificationError);\n        // Don't throw error - application was still created successfully\n      }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send a collaboration request notification to a user for a screenplay/project.\n   * This does NOT add them to teamMembers directly; approval is required.\n   */\n  static async sendCollaborationRequest({\n    inviteeId,\n    inviterId,\n    screenplayId,\n    screenplayName,\n    inviterName\n  }: {\n    inviteeId: string;\n    inviterId: string;\n    screenplayId: string;\n    screenplayName: string;\n    inviterName: string;\n  }): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check for existing pending request\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', inviteeId),\n        where('type', '==', 'collaboration_request'),\n        where('relatedScreenplayId', '==', screenplayId),\n        where('relatedUserId', '==', inviterId),\n      );\n      const existing = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n      if (!existing.empty) {\n        throw new Error('A collaboration request is already pending for this user and screenplay.');\n      }\n      // Create the notification\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), {\n        userId: inviteeId,\n        type: 'collaboration_request',\n        title: 'Collaboration Request',\n        message: &#96;${inviterName} has invited you to collaborate on \"${screenplayName}\".&#96;,\n        relatedScreenplayId: screenplayId,\n        relatedUserId: inviterId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/screenplays/${screenplayId}/collab-request&#96;\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending collaboration request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        ],
        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Send a collaboration request notification to a user for a screenplay/project.\n   * This does NOT add them to teamMembers directly; approval is required.\n   */\n  static async sendCollaborationRequest({\n    inviteeId,\n    inviterId,\n    screenplayId,\n    screenplayName,\n    inviterName\n  }: {\n    inviteeId: string;\n    inviterId: string;\n    screenplayId: string;\n    screenplayName: string;\n    inviterName: string;\n  }): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check for existing pending request\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', inviteeId),\n        where('type', '==', 'collaboration_request'),\n        where('relatedScreenplayId', '==', screenplayId),\n        where('relatedUserId', '==', inviterId),\n      );\n      const existing = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n      if (!existing.empty) {\n        throw new Error('A collaboration request is already pending for this user and screenplay.');\n      }\n      // Create the notification\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), {\n        userId: inviteeId,\n        type: 'collaboration_request',\n        title: 'Collaboration Request',\n        message: &#96;${inviterName} has invited you to collaborate on \"${screenplayName}\".&#96;,\n        relatedScreenplayId: screenplayId,\n        relatedUserId: inviterId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/screenplays/${screenplayId}/collab-request&#96;\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending collaboration request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",
        "range": {

        "contents": "\n\nexport function useNotifications() {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState\u003cNotification[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setNotifications([]);\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n    const q = query(\n      collection(db, \"users\", currentUser.uid, \"notifications\"),\n      orderBy(\"timestamp\", \"desc\")\n    );\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const notifs: Notification[] = snapshot.docs.map((doc) =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data(),\n      })) as Notification[];\n      setNotifications(notifs);\n      setLoading(false);\n    });\n    return () =\u003e unsubscribe();\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  const markAsRead = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    const notifRef = doc(db, \"users\", currentUser.uid, \"notifications\", notificationId);\n    await updateDoc(notifRef, { read: true });\n  };\n\n  return { notifications, loading, markAsRead };\n}",

        "contents": "const CollaborativeTasksHub: React.FC\u003cCollaborativeTasksHubProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleCreateTask = async (taskData: Partial\u003cCollaborativeTask\u003e) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const currentUser = auth.currentUser;\n      if (!currentUser) {\n        toast.error('You must be logged in to create tasks');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const newTask: CollaborativeTask = {\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\n        projectId,\n        title: taskData.title || '',\n        description: taskData.description || '',\n        status: 'pending',\n        priority: taskData.priority || 'medium',\n        dueDate: taskData.dueDate || '',\n        createdBy: currentUser.uid,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n        assignedTeamMembers: taskData.assignedTeamMembers || [],\n        subtasks: taskData.subtasks || [],\n        reminders: [],\n        tags: taskData.tags || [],\n        attachments: [],\n        comments: [],\n        dependencies: [],\n        estimatedHours: taskData.estimatedHours,\n        category: taskData.category || 'other',\n        location: taskData.location,\n        budget: taskData.budget,\n        notes: taskData.notes\n      };\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'collaborativeTasks'), newTask);\n      \n      // Send notifications to assigned team members\n      const assignedMemberIds = newTask.assignedTeamMembers\n        .filter(member =\u003e member.userId)\n        .map(member =\u003e member.userId);\n      \n      if (assignedMemberIds.length \u003e 0) {\n        await sendTaskAssignmentNotification(newTask.id, assignedMemberIds);\n      }\n\n      setShowTaskForm(false);\n      setEditingTask(null);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error creating task:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to create task.         "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleCreateTask = async (taskData: Partial\u003cCollaborativeTask\u003e) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const currentUser = auth.currentUser;\n      if (!currentUser) {\n        toast.error('You must be logged in to create tasks');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const newTask: CollaborativeTask = {\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\n        projectId,\n        title: taskData.title || '',\n        description: taskData.description || '',\n        status: 'pending',\n        priority: taskData.priority || 'medium',\n        dueDate: taskData.dueDate || '',\n        createdBy: currentUser.uid,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n        assignedTeamMembers: taskData.assignedTeamMembers || [],\n        subtasks: taskData.subtasks || [],\n        reminders: [],\n        tags: taskData.tags || [],\n        attachments: [],\n        comments: [],\n        dependencies: [],\n        estimatedHours: taskData.estimatedHours,\n        category: taskData.category || 'other',\n        location: taskData.location,\n        budget: taskData.budget,\n        notes: taskData.notes\n      };\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'collaborativeTasks'), newTask);\n      \n      // Send notifications to assigned team members\n      const assignedMemberIds = newTask.assignedTeamMembers\n        .filter(member =\u003e member.userId)\n        .map(member =\u003e member.userId);\n      \n      if (assignedMemberIds.length \u003e 0) {\n        await sendTaskAssignmentNotification(newTask.id, assignedMemberIds);\n      }\n\n      setShowTaskForm(false);\n      setEditingTask(null);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error creating task:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to create task. Please try again.');\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport class MessagingService {\n  private static listeners = new Map\u003cstring, () =\u003e void\u003e();\n  private static messageCache = new Map\u003cstring, DirectMessage[]\u003e();\n  private static conversationCache = new Map\u003cstring, ConversationSummary[]\u003e();\n  private static typingUsers = new Map\u003cstring, Set\u003cstring\u003e\u003e();\n\n  // ===== DIRECT MESSAGE OPERATIONS =====\n  \n  static async sendDirectMessage(\n    senderId: string, \n    receiverId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'voice' | 'project_invite' = 'text', \n    relatedProjectId?: string,\n    fileUrl?: string\n  ): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Sending direct message from', senderId, 'to', receiverId);\n      \n      // Check permissions\n      const canMessage = await this.canSendMessage(senderId, receiverId);\n      if (!canMessage) {\n        throw new Error('Cannot send message to this user. They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        receiverId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'directMessages'), messageData);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst NotificationCenter: React.FC\u003cNotificationCenterProps\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const { notifications, loading, markAsRead } = useNotifications();\n  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('all');\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n\n  const handleMarkAsRead = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await markAsRead(notificationId);\n      toast.success('Notification marked as read');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error marking notification as read:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to mark as read');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteNotification = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', currentUser!.uid, 'notifications', notificationId));\n      toast.success('Notification deleted');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting notification:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to delete notification');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleNotificationClick = (notification: any) =\u003e {\n    // Mark as read\n    if (!notification.read) {\n      handleMarkAsRead(notification.id);\n    }\n\n    // Navigate based on notification type\n    switch (notification.type) {\n      case 'job_application':\n        navigate(&#96;/jobs/${notification.relatedId}/applications&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_message':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_status_update':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      default:\n        // Default navigation\n        break;\n    }\n    \n    onClose();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst NotificationCenter: React.FC\u003cNotificationCenterProps\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const { notifications, loading, markAsRead } = useNotifications();\n  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('all');\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n\n  const handleMarkAsRead = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await markAsRead(notificationId);\n      toast.success('Notification marked as read');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error marking notification as read:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to mark as read');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteNotification = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', currentUser!.uid, 'notifications', notificationId));\n      toast.success('Notification deleted');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting notification:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to delete notification');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleNotificationClick = (notification: any) =\u003e {\n    // Mark as read\n    if (!notification.read) {\n      handleMarkAsRead(notification.id);\n    }\n\n    // Navigate based on notification type\n    switch (notification.type) {\n      case 'job_application':\n        navigate(&#96;/jobs/${notification.relatedId}/applications&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_message':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_status_update':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      default:\n        // Default navigation\n        break;\n    }\n    \n    onClose();\n  };",

        "contents": "export const AdvancedMessaging: React.FC\u003cAdvancedMessagingProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Send message\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() \u0026\u0026 !replyTo) return;\n\n    try {\n      performanceMonitor.start('sendMessage');\n      \n      const conversationId = [currentUserId, recipientId].sort().join('_');\n      \n      const messageData = {\n        senderId: currentUserId,\n        senderName: 'Current User', // This would come from user profile\n        content: newMessage.trim(),\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        reactions: {},\n        isEdited: false,\n        replyTo: replyTo ? {\n          messageId: replyTo.id,\n          content: replyTo.content,\n          senderName: replyTo.senderName\n        } : undefined\n      };\n\n      await addDoc(collection(db, &#96;conversations/${conversationId}/messages&#96;), messageData);\n      \n      setNewMessage('');\n      setReplyTo(null);\n      performanceMonitor.end('sendMessage');\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', err);\n      setError('Failed to send message');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Add reaction\n  const addReaction = async (messageId: string, emoji: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const conversationId = [currentUserId, recipientId].sort().join('_');\n      const messageRef = doc(db, &#96;conversations/${conversationId}/messages&#96;, messageId);\n      \n      const message = messages.find(m =\u003e m.id === messageId);\n      if (!message) return;\n\n      const updatedReactions = { ...message.reactions };\n      if (!updatedReactions[emoji]) {\n        updatedReactions[emoji] = [];\n      }\n\n      const userIndex = updatedReactions[emoji].indexOf(currentUserId);\n      if (userIndex \u003e -1) {\n        updatedReactions[emoji].splice(userIndex, 1);\n        if (updatedReactions[emoji].length === 0) {\n          delete updatedReactions[emoji];\n        }\n      } else {\n        updatedReactions[emoji].push(currentUserId);\n      }\n\n      await updateDoc(messageRef, { reactions: updatedReactions });\n      setShowReactions(null);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Error adding reaction:', err);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {

Here’s a direct, actionable summary and next steps to address your **highest priority: notifications for incoming requests/messages** and the other issues you listed.

---

## **1. Why Notifications Are Not Working for Incoming Requests/Messages**

### **Root Cause**
- **Your frontend is listening for notifications in `/users/{userId}/notifications`** (see `useNotifications.ts`).
- **Your backend (Cloud Function) and some services write notifications to `/users/{userId}/notifications`** (correct).
- **BUT**: Many other notification-creating functions (e.g., job application, messaging, social, collaboration) are writing to `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications` (flat collections), **not** to the per-user subcollection.

### **Result**
- **Notifications only show up if they are written to `/users/{userId}/notifications`**.
- **All notifications written to `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications` are invisible to your notification center.**

---

## **2. What Needs to Be Fixed (in order of impact)**

### **A. Unify Notification Writes**
- **All notification-creating code must write to `/users/{userId}/notifications`** (not `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications`).

### **B. Ensure Recipient Gets Notification**
- **When a message is sent, create a notification for the recipient** (not just the sender).
- **When a job application is submitted, create a notification for the job poster** (already done in Cloud Function, but double-check).
- **When a job application is approved, create a notification for the applicant.**
- **When a collaborator is added, create a notification for the invitee.**

### **C. Notification Center UI**
- **Make notification modal dismissible** (already fixed, but will double-check).
- **Fix notification list to show all relevant notifications** (should work once backend is fixed).

---

## **3. Immediate Fixes I Will Make**

1. **Refactor all notification-creating code to write to `/users/{userId}/notifications`**.
2. **Ensure all relevant events (messages, applications, approvals, collaborations) create notifications for the correct recipient.**
3. **Add “other” to tag categories with its own color.**
4. **Remove duplicate “Apply Now”, “Open Chat”, and “Save Job” buttons.**

---

## **Let’s Start With the Most Critical: Notification Writes**

**I will now:**
- Refactor all notification-creating code to use `/users/{userId}/notifications`.
- Ensure all relevant events create notifications for the recipient.

You will see real code changes for these fixes, starting now.  
**Once this is done, your notification center will show all incoming requests and messages as expected.**

---

just try the operation directly\n      // Firebase will handle connection issues automatically\n      \n      // Filter out undefined values to prevent Firestore errors\n      const cleanApplication = Object.fromEntries(\n        Object.entries(application).filter(([_, value]) =\u003e value !== undefined)\n      );\n      \n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Cleaned application data:', cleanApplication);\n      \n      const applicationData = {\n        ...cleanApplication,\n        appliedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        status: 'pending' as const\n      };\n\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'jobApplications'), applicationData);\n      \n      // Update job posting application count (optional - don't fail if user can't update)\n      try {\n        const jobRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId);\n        await updateDoc(jobRef, {\n          applicationsCount: firestoreIncrement(1)\n        });\n      } catch (updateError) {\n        console.log('[JobApplicationService] Could not update job application count (this is expected for non-owners):', updateError);\n        // Don't throw error - application was still created successfully\n      }\n\n      // Create notification for the job poster (optional)\n      try {\n        await this.createApplicationNotification(application.jobId, docRef.id, application.applicantId);\n      } catch (notificationError) {\n        console.log('[JobApplicationService] Could not create notification (this is expected):', notificationError);\n        // Don't throw error - application was still created successfully\n      }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send a collaboration request notification to a user for a screenplay/project.\n   * This does NOT add them to teamMembers directly; approval is required.\n   */\n  static async sendCollaborationRequest({\n    inviteeId,\n    inviterId,\n    screenplayId,\n    screenplayName,\n    inviterName\n  }: {\n    inviteeId: string;\n    inviterId: string;\n    screenplayId: string;\n    screenplayName: string;\n    inviterName: string;\n  }): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check for existing pending request\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', inviteeId),\n        where('type', '==', 'collaboration_request'),\n        where('relatedScreenplayId', '==', screenplayId),\n        where('relatedUserId', '==', inviterId),\n      );\n      const existing = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n      if (!existing.empty) {\n        throw new Error('A collaboration request is already pending for this user and screenplay.');\n      }\n      // Create the notification\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), {\n        userId: inviteeId,\n        type: 'collaboration_request',\n        title: 'Collaboration Request',\n        message: &#96;${inviterName} has invited you to collaborate on \"${screenplayName}\".&#96;,\n        relatedScreenplayId: screenplayId,\n        relatedUserId: inviterId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/screenplays/${screenplayId}/collab-request&#96;\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending collaboration request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Send a collaboration request notification to a user for a screenplay/project.\n   * This does NOT add them to teamMembers directly; approval is required.\n   */\n  static async sendCollaborationRequest({\n    inviteeId,\n    inviterId,\n    screenplayId,\n    screenplayName,\n    inviterName\n  }: {\n    inviteeId: string;\n    inviterId: string;\n    screenplayId: string;\n    screenplayName: string;\n    inviterName: string;\n  }): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check for existing pending request\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', inviteeId),\n        where('type', '==', 'collaboration_request'),\n        where('relatedScreenplayId', '==', screenplayId),\n        where('relatedUserId', '==', inviterId),\n      );\n      const existing = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n      if (!existing.empty) {\n        throw new Error('A collaboration request is already pending for this user and screenplay.');\n      }\n      // Create the notification\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), {\n        userId: inviteeId,\n        type: 'collaboration_request',\n        title: 'Collaboration Request',\n        message: &#96;${inviterName} has invited you to collaborate on \"${screenplayName}\".&#96;,\n        relatedScreenplayId: screenplayId,\n        relatedUserId: inviterId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/screenplays/${screenplayId}/collab-request&#96;\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending collaboration request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static subscribeToNotifications(userId: string, callback: (notifications: SocialNotification[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up notifications listener for user:', userId);\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', userId),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(notificationsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const notifications = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n            id: doc.id,\n            ...doc.data(),\n            createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate()\n          })) as SocialNotification[];\n          console.log('[SocialService] Notifications updated:', notifications.length);\n          callback(notifications);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing notifications snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Notifications listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up notifications listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static subscribeToNotifications(userId: string, callback: (notifications: SocialNotification[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up notifications listener for user:', userId);\n      const notificationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'notifications'),\n        where('userId', '==', userId),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(notificationsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const notifications = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n            id: doc.id,\n            ...doc.data(),\n            createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate()\n          })) as SocialNotification[];\n          console.log('[SocialService] Notifications updated:', notifications.length);\n          callback(notifications);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing notifications snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Notifications listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up notifications listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\nexport class MessagingService {\n  private static listeners = new Map\u003cstring, () =\u003e void\u003e();\n  private static messageCache = new Map\u003cstring, DirectMessage[]\u003e();\n  private static conversationCache = new Map\u003cstring, ConversationSummary[]\u003e();\n  private static typingUsers = new Map\u003cstring, Set\u003cstring\u003e\u003e();\n\n  // ===== DIRECT MESSAGE OPERATIONS =====\n  \n  static async sendDirectMessage(\n    senderId: string, \n    receiverId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'voice' | 'project_invite' = 'text', \n    relatedProjectId?: string,\n    fileUrl?: string\n  ): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Sending direct message from', senderId, 'to', receiverId);\n      \n      // Check permissions\n      const canMessage = await this.canSendMessage(senderId, receiverId);\n      if (!canMessage) {\n        throw new Error('Cannot send message to this user. They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        receiverId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'directMessages'), messageData);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport class MessagingService {\n  private static listeners = new Map\u003cstring, () =\u003e void\u003e();\n  private static messageCache = new Map\u003cstring, DirectMessage[]\u003e();\n  private static conversationCache = new Map\u003cstring, ConversationSummary[]\u003e();\n  private static typingUsers = new Map\u003cstring, Set\u003cstring\u003e\u003e();\n\n  // ===== DIRECT MESSAGE OPERATIONS =====\n  \n  static async sendDirectMessage(\n    senderId: string, \n    receiverId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'voice' | 'project_invite' = 'text', \n    relatedProjectId?: string,\n    fileUrl?: string\n  ): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Sending direct message from', senderId, 'to', receiverId);\n      \n      // Check permissions\n      const canMessage = await this.canSendMessage(senderId, receiverId);\n      if (!canMessage) {\n        throw new Error('Cannot send message to this user. They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        receiverId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'directMessages'), messageData);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst NotificationCenter: React.FC\u003cNotificationCenterProps\u003e = ({ isOpen, onClose }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const { notifications, loading, markAsRead } = useNotifications();\n  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('all');\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\n\n  const handleMarkAsRead = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await markAsRead(notificationId);\n      toast.success('Notification marked as read');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error marking notification as read:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to mark as read');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteNotification = async (notificationId: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', currentUser!.uid, 'notifications', notificationId));\n      toast.success('Notification deleted');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting notification:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to delete notification');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleNotificationClick = (notification: any) =\u003e {\n    // Mark as read\n    if (!notification.read) {\n      handleMarkAsRead(notification.id);\n    }\n\n    // Navigate based on notification type\n    switch (notification.type) {\n      case 'job_application':\n        navigate(&#96;/jobs/${notification.relatedId}/applications&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_message':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      case 'application_status_update':\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${notification.applicationId}&#96;);\n        break;\n      default:\n        // Default navigation\n        break;\n    }\n    \n    onClose();\n  };",

        "contents": "export const AdvancedMessaging: React.FC\u003cAdvancedMessagingProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Send message\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() \u0026\u0026 !replyTo) return;\n\n    try {\n      performanceMonitor.start('sendMessage');\n      \n      const conversationId = [currentUserId, recipientId].sort().join('_');\n      \n      const messageData = {\n        senderId: currentUserId,\n        senderName: 'Current User', // This would come from user profile\n        content: newMessage.trim(),\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        reactions: {},\n        isEdited: false,\n        replyTo: replyTo ? {\n          messageId: replyTo.id,\n          content: replyTo.content,\n          senderName: replyTo.senderName\n        } : undefined\n      };\n\n      await addDoc(collection(db, &#96;conversations/${conversationId}/messages&#96;), messageData);\n      \n      setNewMessage('');\n      setReplyTo(null);\n      performanceMonitor.end('sendMessage');\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', err);\n      setError('Failed to send message');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Add reaction\n  const addReaction = async (messageId: string, emoji: string) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const conversationId = [currentUserId, recipientId].sort().join('_');\n      const messageRef = doc(db, &#96;conversations/${conversationId}/messages&#96;, messageId);\n      \n      const message = messages.find(m =\u003e m.id === messageId);\n      if (!message) return;\n\n      const updatedReactions = { ...message.reactions };\n      if (!updatedReactions[emoji]) {\n        updatedReactions[emoji] = [];\n      }\n\n      const userIndex = updatedReactions[emoji].indexOf(currentUserId);\n      if (userIndex \u003e -1) {\n        updatedReactions[emoji].splice(userIndex, 1);\n        if (updatedReactions[emoji].length === 0) {\n          delete updatedReactions[emoji];\n        }\n      } else {\n        updatedReactions[emoji].push(currentUserId);\n      }\n\n      await updateDoc(messageRef, { reactions: updatedReactions });\n      setShowReactions(null);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Error adding reaction:', err);\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "const RealTimeCollaboration: React.FC\u003cRealTimeCollaborationProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Listen to typing indicators\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(\n      collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'typing'),\n      (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        const typingUsers: {[key: string]: boolean} = {};\n        snapshot.docs.forEach(doc =\u003e {\n          const data = doc.data();\n          if (data.isTyping \u0026\u0026 data.timestamp) {\n            const timeDiff = Date.now() - data.timestamp.toDate().getTime();\n            if (timeDiff \u003c 3000) {\n              typingUsers[doc.id] = true;\n            }\n          }\n        });\n        setIsTyping(typingUsers);\n      }\n    );\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() || !session || !currentUser) return;\n\n    try {\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'messages'), {\n        text: newMessage.trim(),\n        senderId: currentUser.uid,\n        senderName: currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'text'\n      });\n\n      // Update session last activity\n      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id), {\n        lastActivity: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      setNewMessage('');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to send message');\n    }\n  };",

Here’s what I found and what I will do to **fix notifications for all incoming requests/messages** and make your notification system work as expected:

---

## **Root Problem**
- **Notifications are being written to different places**:
  - Some to `/users/{userId}/notifications` (what your frontend expects)
  - Many to `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications` (which your frontend does NOT read)
- **Result:** You only see notifications that are written to `/users/{userId}/notifications`. All others are invisible.

---

## **What I Will Do (Fix Plan)**

### **1. Refactor All Notification Writes**
- Change all code that does:
  ```js
  addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), { ... })
  ```
  **to instead do:**
  ```js
  addDoc(collection(db, 'users', userId, 'notifications'), { ... })
  ```
  (and same for `applicationNotifications` etc.)

### **2. Ensure Recipient Gets Notification**
- When a message is sent, create a notification for the *recipient*.
- When a job application is submitted, create a notification for the *job poster*.
- When a job application is approved, create a notification for the *applicant*.
- When a collaborator is added, create a notification for the *invitee*.

### **3. Add “other” to Tag Categories**
- Add “other” to the tag selector and color map.

---

## **I will now begin the code changes for these fixes.**

You will see real, incremental code edits for each of these points, starting with the notification write refactor.  
**Once this is done, your notification center will show all incoming requests and messages as expected.**

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static async updateApplicationStatus(applicationId: string, status: JobApplication['status'], notes?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Updating application status:', applicationId, 'to', status);\n      \n      const updateData: any = {\n        status,\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      if (status === 'reviewed') {\n        updateData.reviewedAt = serverTimestamp();\n      }\n\n      if (notes) {\n        updateData.notes = notes;\n      }\n\n      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId), updateData);\n\n      // Create notification for the applicant\n      const application = await this.getApplication(applicationId);\n      if (application) {\n        await this.createStatusUpdateNotification(applicationId, application.applicantId, status);\n      }\n\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Application status updated successfully');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating application status:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class JobApplicationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Real-time Listeners\n  static subscribeToUserApplications(userId: string, callback: (applications: JobApplication[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      const applicationsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'jobApplications'),\n        where('applicantId', '==', userId),\n        orderBy('appliedAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(applicationsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        const applications = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data()\n        })) as JobApplication[];\n        callback(applications);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error setting up applications listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

ApplicationMessage,\n  ApplicationNotification\n} from '../types/JobApplication';\n\nexport class JobApplicationService {\n  // Job Search Operations\n  static async searchJobs(filters:         "contents": "export class JobApplicationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // User can delete/withdraw their own application\n  static async deleteApplication(applicationId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Deleting application:', applicationId);\n      \n      // Get the application to update job posting count\n      const application = await this.getApplication(applicationId);\n      \n      // Delete the application\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      \n      // Update job posting application count if possible\n      if (application) {\n        try {\n          const jobRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId);\n          await updateDoc(jobRef, {\n            applicationsCount: firestoreIncrement(-1)\n          });\n        } catch (updateError) {\n          console.log('[JobApplicationService] Could not update job application count:', updateError);\n          // Don't throw error - application was still deleted successfully\n        }\n      }\n\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Application deleted successfully');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting application:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Dashboard Operations\n  static async getUserDashboard(userId: string): Promise\u003cJobApplicationDashboard\u003e {\n    try {\n      const applications = await this.getUserApplications(userId);\n      \n      const stats = {\n        total: applications.length,\n        pending: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'pending').length,\n        reviewed: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'reviewed').length,\n        shortlisted: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'shortlisted').length,\n        interviewed: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'interviewed').length,\n        hired: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'hired').length,\n        rejected: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'rejected').length,\n      };\n\n      const recentActivity = applications.slice(0, 10).map(app =\u003e ({\n        id: app.id,\n        type: 'application_submitted' as const,\n        jobId: app.jobId,\n        jobTitle: 'Job Title', // You'd need to fetch this from the job posting\n        timestamp: app.appliedAt,\n        details: &#96;Application submitted for ${app.jobId}&#96;\n      }));\n\n      return {\n        userId,\n        applications,\n        savedJobs: [], // TODO: Implement saved jobs\n        recommendedJobs: [], // TODO: Implement recommendations\n        applicationStats: stats,\n        recentActivity\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting user dashboard:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n ...\n // Reduced cache size for better memory management\n\n  // Follow Request Operations\n  static async sendFollowRequest(fromUserId: string, toUserId: string, message?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Sending follow request:', { fromUserId, toUserId, message });\n      \n      // Check if request already exists\n      const existingRequest = await this.getFollowRequest(fromUserId, toUserId);\n      if (existingRequest) {\n        console.log('[SocialService] Follow request already exists');\n        throw new Error('Follow request already exists');\n      }\n\n      // Check if already following\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(fromUserId, toUserId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        console.log('[SocialService] Already following this user');\n        throw new Error('Already following this user');\n      }\n\n      // Get user names for display\n      const fromUserName = await UserUtils.getUserDisplayName(fromUserId);\n      const toUserName = await UserUtils.getUserDisplayName(toUserId);\n\n      const requestData = {\n        fromUserId,\n        toUserId,\n        fromUserName,\n        toUserName,\n        status: 'pending' as const,\n        message: message || '',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      console.log('[SocialService] Creating follow request with data:', requestData);\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'followRequests'), requestData);\n      console.log('[SocialService] Follow request created successfully');\n\n      // Create notification for the target user\n      console.log('[SocialService] Creating notification for user:', toUserId);\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: toUserId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        title: 'New Follow Request',\n        message: &#96;${fromUserName} wants to follow you&#96;,\n        relatedUserId: fromUserId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/social/requests&#96;\n      });\n      console.log('[SocialService] Notification created successfully');\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }",

        "originalContents": " // Reduced cache size for better memory management\n\n  // Follow Request Operations\n  static async sendFollowRequest(fromUserId: string, toUserId: string, message?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Sending follow request:', { fromUserId, toUserId, message });\n      \n      // Check if request already exists\n      const existingRequest = await this.getFollowRequest(fromUserId, toUserId);\n      if (existingRequest) {\n        console.log('[SocialService] Follow request already exists');\n        throw new Error('Follow request already exists');\n      }\n\n      // Check if already following\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(fromUserId, toUserId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        console.log('[SocialService] Already following this user');\n        throw new Error('Already following this user');\n      }\n\n      // Get user names for display\n      const fromUserName = await UserUtils.getUserDisplayName(fromUserId);\n      const toUserName = await UserUtils.getUserDisplayName(toUserId);\n\n      const requestData = {\n        fromUserId,\n        toUserId,\n        fromUserName,\n        toUserName,\n        status: 'pending' as const,\n        message: message || '',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      console.log('[SocialService] Creating follow request with data:', requestData);\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'followRequests'), requestData);\n      console.log('[SocialService] Follow request created successfully');\n\n      // Create notification for the target user\n      console.log('[SocialService] Creating notification for user:', toUserId);\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: toUserId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        title: 'New Follow Request',\n        message: &#96;${fromUserName} wants to follow you&#96;,\n        relatedUserId: fromUserId,\n        isRead: false,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        actionUrl: &#96;/social/requests&#96;\n      });\n      console.log('[SocialService] Notification created successfully');\n\n    } catch         "contents": "const RealTimeCollaboration: React.FC\u003cRealTimeCollaborationProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Listen to typing indicators\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(\n      collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'typing'),\n      (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        const typingUsers: {[key: string]: boolean} = {};\n        snapshot.docs.forEach(doc =\u003e {\n          const data = doc.data();\n          if (data.isTyping \u0026\u0026 data.timestamp) {\n            const timeDiff = Date.now() - data.timestamp.toDate().getTime();\n            if (timeDiff \u003c 3000) {\n              typingUsers[doc.id] = true;\n            }\n          }\n        });\n        setIsTyping(typingUsers);\n      }\n    );\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() || !session || !currentUser) return;\n\n    try {\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'messages'), {\n        text: newMessage.trim(),\n        senderId: currentUser.uid,\n        senderName: currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'text'\n      });\n\n      // Update session last activity\n      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id), {\n        lastActivity: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      setNewMessage('');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to send message');\n    }\n  };",

{\n      try {\n        // Check if session exists\n        const sessionQuery = query(\n          collection(db, 'collaborationSessions'),\n          where('projectId', '==', projectId)\n        );\n\n        const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(sessionQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n          if (!snapshot.empty) {\n            const sessionData = snapshot.docs[0].data() as CollaborationSession;\n }\n        });\n\n        return unsubscribe;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error initializing collaboration session:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to join collaboration const batch = writeBatch(db);\n      const requestRef = doc(db, 'followRequests', requestId);\n\n      // Update request status instead of deleting\n      batch.update(requestRef, {\n        status,\n };\n        const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n        batch.set(followRef, followData);\n\n        // Create notification for the requester\n        await this.createNotification({\n toUserId,\n          isRead: false,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n          actionUrl: &#96;/social/profile/${toUserId}&#96;\n        });\n\n        // Create activity feed item\n        await         "originalContents": "\n\n  static async respondToFollowRequest(requestId: string, status: 'accepted' | 'rejected'): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const batch = writeBatch(db);\n      const requestRef = doc(db, 'followRequests', requestId);\n\n      // Update request status instead of deleting\n      batch.update(requestRef, {\n        status,\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Get the request data\n      const requestDoc = await getDoc(requestRef);\n      if (!requestDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Follow request not found');\n      }\n\n      const requestData = requestDoc.data();\n      const { fromUserId, toUserId } = requestData;\n\n      if (status === 'accepted') {\n        // Create follow relationship\n        const followData = {\n          followerId: fromUserId,\n          followingId: toUserId,\n          status: 'active' as const,\n          createdAt: serverTimestamp()\n        };\n        const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n        batch.set(followRef, followData);\n\n        // Create notification for the requester\n        await this.createNotification({\n          userId: isRead: false,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n          actionUrl: &#96;/social/profile/${toUserId}&#96;\n        });\n\n        // Create activity feed item\n        await this.createActivityFeedItem({\n          userId: fromUserId,\n          type: 'follow_made',\n          title: 'New Follower',\n          description: 'You gained a new follower',\n          relatedUserId: toUserId,\n          likes: 0,\n          comments: 0,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n          isPublic: true\n        });\n      }\n\n      await batch.commit();\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error responding to follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Add annotation to screenplay (reference version)\n  const addAnnotation = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newAnnotation.trim() || !uploadedScreenplay) return;\n    try {\n      const annotationData = {\n        screenplayId: uploadedScreenplay.id,\n        userId: currentUser?.uid || 'unknown',\n        userName: currentUser?.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n        annotation: newAnnotation.trim(),\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n        projectId: projectId || 'default-project'\n      };\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'), annotationData);\n      setScreenplayAnnotations(prev =\u003e [...prev, {\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\n        userId: currentUser?.uid || 'unknown',\n        userName: currentUser?.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n        annotation: newAnnotation.trim(),\n        timestamp: new Date()\n      }]);\n      setNewAnnotation('');\n      setShowScreenplayViewer(true);\n      toast.success('Annotation added successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error adding annotation:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to add annotation');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Load screenplay annotations (reference version)\n  const loadAnnotations = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!uploadedScreenplay) return;\n    try {\n      const q = query(\n        collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'),\n        where('screenplayId', '==', uploadedScreenplay.id),\n        orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n      );\n      const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n      const annotations = querySnapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as any[];\n      setScreenplayAnnotations(annotations);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading annotations:', error);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const addAnnotation = async (position: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }, pageNumber: number, annotation: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!annotation.trim()) return;\n\n    try {\n      const annotationData = {\n        screenplayId: screenplay.id,\n        userId: currentUser?.uid || 'unknown',\n        userName: currentUser?.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n        userAvatar: currentUser?.photoURL || '',\n        annotation: annotation.trim(),\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n        projectId: projectId,\n        pageNumber,\n        position,\n        replies: [],\n        resolved: false,\n        priority: 'medium' as const\n      };\n\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'), annotationData);\n      setNewAnnotation('');\n      toast.success('Annotation added successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error adding annotation:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to add annotation');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const addTag = async (position: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }, pageNumber: number, tag: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!tag.trim()) return;\n\n    try {\n      const tagData = {\n        screenplayId: screenplay.id,\n        userId: currentUser?.uid || 'unknown',\n        userName: currentUser?.displayName || 'Anonymous',\n        userAvatar: currentUser?.photoURL || '',\n        tagType: selectedTagType,\n        content: tag.trim(),\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n        projectId: projectId,\n        pageNumber,\n        position,\n        color: tagColors[selectedTagType],\n        resolved: false\n      };\n\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'screenplayTags'), tagData);\n      setNewTag('');\n      toast.success('Tag added successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error adding tag:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to add tag');\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const loadAnnotations = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[DEBUG] Querying screenplayAnnotations with screenplayId:', screenplay.id);\n      const q = query(\n        collection(db, 'screenplayAnnotations'),\n        where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n        orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n      );\n      const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n      const annotationsData = querySnapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        const processedReplies = Array.isArray(data.replies)\n          ? data.replies.map((reply: any) =\u003e ({\n              ...reply,\n              timestamp: toDate(reply.timestamp)\n            }))\n          : [];\n        \n        console.log(&#96;[DEBUG] Loaded annotation ${doc.id} with ${processedReplies.length} replies:&#96;, processedReplies);\n        \n        return {\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...data,\n          timestamp: toDate(data.timestamp),\n          replies: processedReplies\n        };\n      }) as Annotation[];\n      setAnnotations(annotationsData);\n      console.log('[DEBUG] Total annotations loaded:', annotationsData.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[DEBUG] Error loading annotations:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadTags = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[DEBUG] Querying screenplayTags with screenplayId:', screenplay.id);\n      const q = query(\n        collection(db, 'screenplayTags'),\n        where('screenplayId', '==', screenplay.id),\n        orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n      );\n      const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n      const tagsData = querySnapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data(),\n        timestamp: toDate(doc.data().timestamp)\n      })) as Tag[];\n      setTags(tagsData);\n      console.log('[DEBUG] Loaded tags:', tagsData);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[DEBUG] Error loading tags:', error);\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "const ScreenplayViewer: React.FC\u003cScreenplayViewerProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handlePopupMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    if (!isDragging) return;\n    \n    const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;\n    const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;\n    \n    // Keep popup within viewport bounds\n    const maxX = window.innerWidth - (popupRef.current?.offsetWidth || 320);\n    const maxY = window.innerHeight - (popupRef.current?.offsetHeight || 200);\n    \n    setPopupPosition({\n      x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, maxX)),\n      y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, maxY))\n    });\n  };\n\n  const handlePopupMouseUp = () =\u003e {\n    setIsDragging(false);\n  };\n\n  // Handle PDF scroll events to prevent background scrolling\n  const handlePdfScroll = (e: React.UIEvent\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    // Allow the scroll to work normally, just prevent it from bubbling up\n    e.stopPropagation();\n  };\n\n  // Handle PDF wheel events to prevent background scrolling\n  const handlePdfWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    // Allow the wheel scroll to work normally, just prevent it from bubbling up\n    e.stopPropagation();\n  };\n\n  // Initialize collaboration session\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('[DEBUG] ScreenplayViewer mounted with screenplay:', screenplay);\n    if (!screenplay.url || typeof screenplay.url !== 'string' || screenplay.url.trim() === '') {\n      setError('No PDF URL found for this screenplay.');\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n    initializeSession();\n    loadAnnotations();\n    loadTags();\n    startRealTimeSync();\n  }, [screenplay.id]);",

        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleSaveJob = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!auth.currentUser) {\n      toast.error('Please log in to save jobs');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      if (isSaved) {\n        // Remove from saved\n        const { savedJobId } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(auth.currentUser.uid, jobId!);\n        if (savedJobId) {\n          await SavedJobsService.removeSavedJob(savedJobId);\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          toast.success('Job removed from saved');\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Add to saved\n        await SavedJobsService.saveJob(auth.currentUser.uid, jobId!);\n        setIsSaved(true);\n        toast.success('Job saved successfully');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Error saving job:', error);\n      \n      // Handle connection issues\n      if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n        toast.error('Connection issue. Please try again.');\n      } else {\n        toast.error('Failed to save job. Please try again.');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n        });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Don't log AbortError as it's just user cancellation\n        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {\n          console.error('Error sharing:', error);\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Fallback to clipboard\n      try {\n        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);\n        toast.success('Job link copied to clipboard');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error copying to clipboard:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to copy link');\n      }\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async (retryCount = 0) =\u003e {\n    if (!jobId) {\n      setError('No job ID provided');\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      setConnectionStatus('connecting');\n      \n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId));\n      \n      if (!jobDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Job not found');\n      }\n      \n      const data = jobDoc.data();\n      \n      // Map the Firestore document to the JobPosting interface\n      const jobData: JobPosting = {\n        id: jobDoc.id,\n        title: data.title || '',\n        department: data.department || '',\n        jobTitle: data.title || '',\n        description: data.description || '',\n        requirements: typeof data.requirements === 'string' ?         "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };\n\n  const getTimeAgo = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffInHours = Math.floor((now.getTime() - dateObj.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60));\n    \n    if (diffInHours \u003c 1) return 'Just now';\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 24) return &#96;${diffInHours}h ago&#96;;\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 168) return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 24)}d ago&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 168)}w ago&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const getExperienceLevelColor = (level: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (level) {\n      case 'entry': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'mid': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'senior': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'executive': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const formatSalary = (salary: { min?: number; max?: number; currency?: string } | undefined) =\u003e {\n    if (!salary || (salary.min === undefined \u0026\u0026 salary.max === undefined)) return 'Salary not specified';\n    const { min, max, currency = 'USD' } = salary;\n    if (min !== undefined \u0026\u0026 max !== undefined) {\n      if (min === max) {\n        return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n      }\n      return &#96;${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()} - ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (min !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;From ${currency} ${min.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    } else if (max !== undefined) {\n      return &#96;Up to ${currency} ${max.toLocaleString()}&#96;;\n    }\n    return 'Salary not specified';\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { \n      year: 'numeric', \n      month: 'short', \n      day: 'numeric' \n    });\n  };\n\n  const getTimeAgo = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return '';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffInHours = Math.floor((now.getTime() - dateObj.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60));\n    \n    if (diffInHours \u003c 1) return 'Just now';\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 24) return &#96;${diffInHours}h ago&#96;;\n    if (diffInHours \u003c 168) return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 24)}d ago&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(diffInHours / 168)}w ago&#96;;\n  };\n\n  const getExperienceLevelColor = (level: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (level) {\n      case 'entry': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'mid': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'senior': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'executive': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };",
